cover.alt: A tikka masala shepherd's pie in a cast-iron dish, with a scoop revealing chicken in a creamy orange-red sauce under golden mashed potato.

s1.alt: A bowl of creamy mashed potatoes with butter, milk, and a potato masher.

s2.alt: Pieces of chicken thigh browning in butter in a wide pan.

s3.alt: Softened onion, spices, and tomato purée cooking into a tikka masala base.

s4.alt: Chicken simmering in a creamy tikka masala sauce, finished with cream, yogurt, and cilantro.

s5.alt: A baked shepherd's pie with a golden fork-roughed mashed potato topping and bubbling tikka masala filling.
